name: McPherson pond (Edward McPherson farm)
period_note: One of only two identified ponds on the 1863 battlefield; it disrupted Col. Roy Stone's brigade on 1 July; it still exists

sources.cite: Treatment Philosophy: The 1863 Landscape, Gettysburg NMP (NPS, 2004), ch. 2-3 (circulation, fencing, water features)
sources.quote_or_paraphrase: There were only two identified ponds on the battlefield in 1863: the McPherson pond, which still exists, and a large pond at the John Biesecker farm, later removed by D. D. Eisenhower; the McPherson pond disrupted Stone's brigade on 1 July.

method: No geometry: the sources read name the pond but give no coordinates (the McPherson farm barn is OSM way 711545174 at 39.8369, -77.2513); the pond outline is NOT located by this layer.
notes: Position not established by a source read here; do not draw until located.
